title: Example 17-10: Inserted Letters

illustrates.quote: Inserted Letters. Spellers often indicate replacement letters within a word to show other spellings. a. Transcribe words with inserted letters in uncontracted braille. b. Follow print for use of enclosure symbols.

print.notes: A word and its altered spelling with an inserted letter shown in parentheses, on a single line.

braille.notes: Byte-identical between A and B; matches independent re-extraction exactly.

resolution: Both runs (A, B) came from the same model (Gemini Pro via Antigravity, 17 Sep 2026) and are not independent; agreement was treated as no evidence. braille.lines independently re-extracted from references/_text/braille-formats-2016.txt (the line-number field, digits + >=3 spaces, or the fixed left margin measured in ASCII spaces before any U+2800 cell, stripped by counting; U+2800->space; trailing spaces removed). Braille and rule id unchanged. Modeled as one wholly-uncontracted paragraph (17.12.1a, 'done'); the print parentheses pass through translate() as an ordinary enclosure symbol (17.12.1b, 'done'). Expect MATCH.
